name: Do I need a permit to install a walk-in shower in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to install a walk-in shower in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many Bay Area cities like Pacifica or Daly City, installing a walk-in shower typically requires a building permit. This is because the project often involves plumbing modifications, structural changes, or alterations to existing waterproof membranes, all of which fall under local building codes. Obtaining a permit ensures the work meets safety and quality standards. A general contractor can help navigate the specific permitting requirements for your city and ensure compliance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a building permit is usually required for walk-in shower installation in Bay Area cities like Pacifica or Daly City due to plumbing and structural changes.
